Why did Jane Austen go to school in Reading?
Jane Austen (born December 16, 1775, Steventon, Hampshire, England—died July 18, 1817, Winchester, Hampshire) was an English writer
like the other Austen children, she was baptized at Steventon rectory on the day of her birth by George Austen.
The formal ceremony took place on 5 April 1776 at St Nicholas's Church, which stood on the rising ground behind the rectory.
English novelist noted for her insightful portrayals of middle-class families (1775-1817)
